note: Textbook against the stated definition. Tech product manager running his own consulting business in New York, previously carrying a $250/mo Equinox membership plus a ~$1,300/mo personal trainer and now a nanny — successful and able to pay. Health is explicitly the one neglected area and he says so himself: 'I'm not the type of person to put my health to the side... it's just when it comes to the get in the gym and sweat, that aspect.' He is not deconditioned — 180-184 lb, 10,000-15,000 steps a day, and 'if you looked at me, you'd be like, okay, he's not out of shape.' The only soft edge is good_to_great: he frames the goal as recovering a former self rather than upgrading a current one, which is nearer rebuild than good-to-great, but he is starting from good and not from rescue. Worth noting that the stated ICP has no clinical criterion and this prospect carries an unresolved shoulder injury and right-side mechanical issues that the criteria do not see at all.
